author: MeijiHKitty
body:
You can play the game perfectly fine not interacting with others

Joining a Kingdom (basically like a guild in other games) does have its benefits though and is highly recommended, even if you don’t interact with your fellow members. Just make sure to try and abide by the Kingdom rules. There’s also the benefit of joining a party for Memory Hunts when trying to get specific ones, but you can definitely get by doing them solo

As for PvP there isn’t too much, but there is certain content that revolves around it like claiming territory and fighting in Blade of Finesse, but it isn’t necessarily if you decide not to

author: dfoley323
body:
You never have to party for any content and can 100% kill everything solo. 

Parties can help speed things up but are 100% not needed

author: PsyavaIG
body: You might enjoy Aetheric more as its built as the single player version

author: KevineCove
body: Even as someone that does a relatively high amount of multiplayer content, 95% of the time I spend in game is doing single player stuff. I think you'll like the game just fine.

author: frosmayn
body: Note that most of PvP in Orna is actually fighting against AI controlled other players so it's perhaps not what you might consider true PvP.  There is some true / live PvP in Orna but it can be completely ignored unless you want all achievs

author: bp019337
body: If you can find a bunch of your friends to play it then its pretty fun just getting together and theory crafting and showing off your drops to each other.  We meet a few times a year when we can and the GPS aspect of it makes it great for pub crawls!  We don't actually play the game together tbh as we all live quite far apart.
